item.title: House Democrats Cast Wide Net as They Prepare Trump Investigations

item.title: After Days of Digital Outages, Americans Wonder if the Country Is Breaking

item.media:description: Flights were halted for hours on Friday after officials issued a nationwide ground stop.

item.title: Rubio Says Cyberattacks Are Not the Cause of Recent Tech Outages

item.title: American A.I. Models Have Potential to Be Turned Against U.S., Study Finds
item.description: An investigation by the Government Accountability Office found that researchers were able to prod chatbots into generating data that could be used in planning or conducting mass-casualty attacks.
item.dc:creator: Dustin Volz
item.category: Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
item.media:description: The study, conducted in the spring at the request of Senator Maggie Hassan, Democrat of New Hampshire, involved chatbots from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and SpaceXAI.

item.title: Trump Administration Presses Ahead in Legal Battle Over U.S. Attorneys

item.title: Google Buys Worker Data From Spirit Airlines in a New Market to Feed A.I.
item.description: A flight attendants’ union challenged Google’s plans to protect personal information in the data in court, saying the company’s measures were not enough to protect Spirit’s employees.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Davis O’Brien
item.media:description: When Spirit Airlines shut down in May, its assets went up for sale, including decades of internal workplace data like employee records, tax forms, 100 million emails and half a billion Microsoft Teams messages.

item.title: These Villagers Wonder if They’re on the Front Line of Russia’s Shadow War

item.media:description: A DHL plane and Russian Antonov cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany. The airport has become a byword for Russian clandestine attacks in Europe.
